name: Master Yi
notes: Opens with R (Highlander) and E (Wuju Style) at t=0 for their buff windows, then Master Yi attacks continuously and casts Q (Alpha Strike) every time it is off cooldown; E is recast on cooldown for the rest of the fight.
Meditate (W) is never cast: it interrupts attacking and its heal/damage-reduction do nothing against a dummy that never attacks back, so it is pure lost DPS uptime here.

Double Strike is read as requiring 3 stacks to trigger the second strike (the wiki's stated cap and leveling text), not the bin's MasterYiPassive.AttackCount=4, since the wiki text is the more direct statement of the trigger count; this is a real, unresolved source disagreement.

Alpha Strike is modeled against the single dummy target as: the primary mark is placed 0.2s after cast and detonates for full damage 1.087s after cast (on reappearance, per the wiki's stated total cast duration with 4 bounces); the other three marks are placed every 0.2s after that (0.4s/0.6s/0.8s) and each detonate instantly for 25% damage, since with only the dummy available every mark re-marks it. Master Yi cannot attack for the full 1.087s.

Alpha Strike's on-hit application (75% effectiveness on the primary detonation, 18.75% on each of the three instant marks) is read as triggering Wuju Style's true damage on-hit, since the wiki says every detonation 'applies on-hit effects'; per the wiki's explicit carve-out it does not generate a Double Strike stack nor reduce Alpha Strike's own cooldown.

Only the first (chronologically earliest) damage instance of an Alpha Strike cast is treated as the hit that counts for Eclipse-style effects, per the wiki's note that only the first instance of Alpha Strike's damage counts as a hit for such effects; that is the first of the three instantly-detonating marks, not the later primary detonation.
Each Alpha Strike detonation refreshes Wuju Style's and Highlander's current durations while they are active, per the wiki.

Alpha Strike's and Double Strike's second strike critical-strike modifiers use the engine's standard crit multiplier: the wiki's BonusCritDamageRatio=1 formula for Alpha Strike reduces exactly to a normal attack's critical damage.

Basic attacks on-hit (including Double Strike's second strike, which itself applies on-hit effects) reduce Alpha Strike's current cooldown by 1 base second, scaled down by ability haste like any other cooldown.
Highlander's 85s cooldown means only the opening cast happens within the modeled fight length; its passive takedown cooldown refund is irrelevant against a dummy that is never killed mid-fight.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
